programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Risk Taking, Money Making"
programme.desc: Torie and Larry duke it out on the auction floor for an incredible artefact. Cole meets astronaut Scott Parazynski who risked his life on one of the most daring spacewalks ever.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Emissaries"
programme.desc: Our solar system is vast, from our own star the Sun to Earth is nearly 150 million kilometers or 1 Astronomical Unit. Jupiter is 5.2 AU distant and Pluto up to 48AU, the solar system extends far beyond this into interstellar space.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Danger Asteroids Ahead"
programme.desc: The question often rises is the cost of space exploration really worth it? Could the money be better spent elsewhere. If so one space program would have to remain. The planetary defence program, to locate identify and deflect a wayward asteroid.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "First Light"
programme.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther – carrying us ever closer to the first light.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Stars Above"
programme.desc: Stars are a bit like human beings. They can be warm or cold, they come in all kinds of shapes and sizes… and, let’s face it, they can be dim or bright. Recent discoveries suggest the number of stars in our galaxy alone may exceed 200 billion.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Declaring Martian Law"
programme.desc: Space is home to crucial resources, important discoveries, and big potential profit.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Sol Ownership: Can A Corporation Own The Sun?"
programme.sub-title: Sol Ownership: Can A Corporation Own The Sun?
programme.desc: Human needs have always created opportunities for human greed. And energy might be the most crucial need of all. Could we end up paying a subscription fee for sunlight?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Terraforming: Can We Build A Planet B?"
programme.sub-title: Terraforming: Can We Build A Planet B?
programme.desc: Once we’ve managed to get a handle on building structures to help us live on the harsh, dangerous surfaces of other celestial bodies -- why stop there?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Carbon Costs: Is Space Exploration Even Worth It?"
programme.sub-title: Carbon Costs: Is Space Exploration Even Worth It?
programme.desc: Each rocket that gets fired off has an impact on the atmosphere. Will Earth be able to survive hundreds, or even thousands, of fuel-burning rocket launches every year.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Mercury Advances"

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Venus Express"
programme.desc: PROJECT GEMINI COMMENCES - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? VENUS EXPRESS - The last days of ESA’s Venus probe. EMU NASA’s - Extravehicular Mobility Unit. DEEP SPACE COMMUNICATIONS - ESA’s worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "The Dark Side"
